A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Self-CriTeach work. Their text, equations, figures, tables and complete appendices support reliable comparison, including matching deleted duplicate displays to retained results.

before.justification: v3 reports original planning evaluations, component and backbone ablations, token-efficiency measurements, and real-robot outcomes in Tables 1–10 and the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains original planning evaluations and ablations in Tables 1–4 and 6–8, real-robot success rates in Table 5, and the VLA demonstration in Appendix A.8.

M1.justification: Section 5.2 adds majority-vote validation of CoT correctness to the described solution-generation procedure. This is a limited procedural addition; domain generation, SFT and CPO objectives, and inference remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether training was rerun.

E1.justification: Both retain Blocks World Classic, Hard and Align, the three transfer tasks, and the UR5e and VLA scenarios. Section 9's new low/high-noise labels describe the existing perception pipelines.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–8, including Majority Vote and the Llama backbone comparison. Replacing the citation accompanying GPT-4o does not change the evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Appendix A.3 changes the stated RL optimizer from AdamW to Adam. This is a reported training-setting revision, without evidence of reruns. Splits, sample counts, training budgets, evaluation metrics and robot-testing procedures are otherwise retained.

E4.justification: Component and backbone ablations, efficiency analysis, noisy-perception experiments and the VLA case study remain. Deleted Appendix A.9 and Tables 9–10 repeat backbone evidence retained in Section 8 and Tables 4, 6 and 7.

E5.justification: Both report ten trials per real-robot task. Neither adds seeds, repeated-training-run statistics, confidence intervals or significance tests. The new CoT voting statement is a method step, not uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Tables 1–8 retain their numerical results, including SCT-4B's overall success rate of 0.46 and progress score of 0.76. Deleted Tables 9–10 duplicate retained Llama results at greater decimal precision; no distinct experimental outcomes are lost.

T1.justification: The planning definitions, symbolic-to-language formulation, SFT loss, CPO objective, reward and constraint equations, and appendix metric definitions are unchanged. Terminology corrections do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: generated domains supply supervision and rewards, symbolic-CoT supports self-teaching, and the resulting models improve planning, generalization, efficiency and noise tolerance.

C2.justification: Removing Appendix A.9 omits its explicit qualification that Llama gains are smaller on unseen tasks, although the supporting scores remain. Section 9 also explicitly labels the existing perception pipelines low/high noise. Main mechanism explanations and Section 10 limitations are retained.

D1.justification: v4 removes the project-website link from the first page. Appendix A.3 changes the reported action-sequence extraction tag from <REASON> to <FINAL> and the RL optimizer from AdamW to Adam; other implementation details largely remain.

R1.justification: v4 removes citations to Brohan et al. (2022), Gupta et al. (2019) and NPG-MUSE, and replaces the GPT-4 technical report with the GPT-4o system card. Broader research positioning remains stable; other reference edits mainly update metadata.

P1.justification: v4 rephrases the abstract and selected explanations, corrects terminology and correspondence information, and replaces numbered appendix subsubsections with run-in headings. The main narrative and section order remain intact.

P2.justification: v4 restyles Figures 2 and 5, corrects Figure 5's caption to identify training data, resizes and relocates Figure 4, and reflows appendix material. Redundant Tables 9–10 are removed; the remaining results tables retain their structure.

improvement.justification: Correcting Figure 5's caption and removing duplicate Llama displays improve clarity without losing results. However, v4 removes the sole project link and does not explain how the newly stated voting step and optimizer revision relate to the retained results. These mixed effects on clarity and reproducibility prevent a reliable net quality judgment.
